We tracked $4.63 billion across 144 deals in the first half, compared with $10.13 billion across 125 deals a year earlier.

• Värde Partners Partners led by investment amount
 • InCred Financial Services Alternatives led by deal count

 • Real estate and utilities together drove half of total volume

EMEA restructuring hit a wall in Q2.

New mandate initiations dropped 32% QoQ as major deals got pushed to H2, a sharp reversal after a fast start to the year. Our H1'26 EMEA Restructuring Advisor League Tables break down who led while the market cooled.

A few highlights:
• Kirkland & Ellis topped large-cap legal by debt volume with €11.665B across 13 mandates
• PJT Partners led large-cap financial advisory with €17.262B, Houlihan Lokey close behind
• Willkie Farr & Gallagher LLP and Grant Thornton took the mid-market legal and financial crowns respectively

Swipe for the full rankings. 👉
